title: BanglaNLP at BLP-2023 Task 1: Benchmarking different Transformer Models for Violence Inciting Text Detection in Bangla
reasoning: The paper's task is Violence Inciting Text Detection, classifying text into 'Non-Violence,' 'Passive Violence,' and 'Direct Violence.' The definitions of 'Passive Violence' and 'Direct Violence' explicitly include derogatory language, abusive remarks, and threats targeting individuals or communities based on their religion, culture, or traditions. This directly relates to moral and ethical considerations concerning hate speech and incitement to violence against specific groups.
